preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 500 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the permutation N is between 2 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(P) == N for N, P in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the permutation P matches the given N.

preconditions.expression: all(sorted(P) == list(range(1, N+1)) for N, P in [(int(input().split()[0]), list(map(int, input().split()))) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, P is a permutation of length N containing all integers from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cost, int) and cost >= 0 for cost in [int(output.split()[0]) for output in stdout.split('\n') if output])
postconditions.description: The minimum total cost to sort the permutation is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(K, int) and 0 <= K <= N**2 for K, N in zip([int(output.split()[1]) for output in stdout.split('\n') if output], [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: The number of operations K is between 0 and N^2 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= i <= N and 1 <= j <= N and i != j for i, j in [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout.split('\n')[2:2+K]]) for K, N in zip([int(output.split()[1]) for output in stdout.split('\n') if output], [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: Each operation consists of two distinct indices i and j between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(P[i-1] == x for i, x in enumerate(sorted(P))) for P in [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)])
postconditions.description: The permutation P is sorted in increasing order after performing the operations.
